title: Video Punch — Zoom Effect, Caption Fixes, Color Variety
goal: Make stock footage clips visually impactful: zoom-punch intro (1.18x→1x over 2.5s), brightness flash at t=0, 5 random caption color presets, text wrapping to prevent truncation, larger hook text in first 2s.

tasks.title: Caption text wrapping
tasks.description: Add wrapNarration() helper that wraps at 20 chars/line for normal segments and 18 for the hook. Prevents text from running off-screen.

tasks.title: Caption color presets
tasks.description: Define 5 CAPTION_PRESETS (white/black, yellow/black, cyan/black, orange/black, neon-green/black). Pick one at random per clip and apply to all narration drawtext filters.

tasks.title: Hook text impact — larger first segment
tasks.description: First narration segment (i===0) rendered at fontsize=98, vertically centered (y=(h-text_h)/2). Remaining segments at fontsize=68, y=130. All segments get 0.15s alpha fade-in.

tasks.title: Zoom-punch intro effect
tasks.description: Replace fixed [fg] scale with eval=frame expression: w='1080*(1+0.18*lt(t,2.5)*(1-t/2.5))'. At t=0 fg is 18% wider than frame (cropped center = zoomed in). Smoothly pulls back to 1080px by t=2.5s.

tasks.title: Brightness flash at t=0
tasks.description: Insert eq=brightness='0.2*exp(-4*t)' stage after subtitle burn. Creates a quick brightness pop that fades by t=0.5s, reinforcing the opening impact.

tasks.title: Enforce shorter narration segments
tasks.description: Update prompt: 'STRICT MAX 6 words per segment — never exceed 6 words'. Reduces probability of long text that wraps badly or appears truncated.
